text: This week, AFB3228 (Adele Fiona Boone), an Electrical Engineer with a typical user profile, triggered two anomaly detection rules. The most significant evidence points to unusual volumes of logons outside their working hours ([R1], [F001]) and browsing activity on job-search sites atypical for the role ([R4], [F002]). Specifically, there were 4 logons outside working hours, which is clearly above her usual range, and 70 visits to job-search sites, exceeding both her typical behavior and that of same-role peers.
